report_meta.title: MFNet Reproduction Report — ISPRS Vaihingen
report_meta.description: MFNet (MMLoRA + SAM ViT-L + UNetFormer decoder) reproduction on ISPRS Vaihingen

model_architecture.name: MFNet-MMLoRA
model_architecture.paper: A Unified Framework With Multimodal Fine-Tuning for Remote Sensing Semantic Segmentation (IEEE TGRS 2025)

fusion.dual_stream: RGB + DSM independently through ViT, fused post-ViT

training_config.data_augmentation: Random 256x256 crop + random flip + random mirror

best_epoch.note: Monitoring eval: stride=32, eroded labels, no edge trim

key_findings: MFNet (SAM1 ViT-L + MMLoRA + UNetFormer) achieves 74.98% mIoU on Vaihingen with aligned evaluation
Training monitoring eval (stride=32) overestimates by ~9pp vs final eval (stride=128, edge trim)
MFNet trains stably for 50 epochs thanks to random crop data diversity (700K samples total)
Plan experiments converge in 3-4 epochs (~7.7K samples) due to fixed crop dataset
SAM1 ViT-L pretrained features provide better initialization than SAM3 ViTDet (init loss 0.67 vs 0.90)
Per-class: building (88.7%) >> road (77.2%) ≈ tree (77.4%) > car (69.0%) > grass (62.6%)
Main confusion: grass↔tree (13.2% recall) and car→road (16.6% recall)
Model never predicts clutter class — training with eroded labels removes clutter boundaries
MFNet lags behind Plan7-A by -2.6pp mIoU but uses a simpler architecture (no prompt, no MMAdapter)
Data volume (not architecture) is the primary factor: MFNet 700K vs Plan 7.7K samples
MFNet result is within noise range of Plan8-CTRL (74.77%), confirming SAM1 baseline ~75%
